Its call ends with triangle_filter_for_2to1=false and supplies no scratch_buffer_2k argument, while S1 requires a scratch slice of at least 2048 bytes and enters the new upsampling implementation only when triangle_filter_for_2to1 is true with a qualifying inverse sampling ratio. The new triangle path partitions scratch_buffer_2k.ptr into offsets 0 * 672, 1 * 672, and 2 * 672 and performs repeated writes in the h2, h3, and h4 upsamplers, making buffer size, placement, and chunk-boundary cases fuzz-worthy.
H0 limits width and height to 1..63, so it cannot exercise the triangle path's 672-pixel chunk boundary or multiple iterations of while (x < width).
H0 fills each source plane using memset with one byte per plane, which substantially suppresses input variation through the new upsampling and color-conversion loops.
recommended_action: Update fuzz_swizzle_ycck to pass a guarded scratch slice and fuzz its valid and short lengths; vary triangle_filter_for_2to1 across false and true; generate qualifying h/v ratios; extend dimensions across 672-pixel boundaries; and populate source planes with fuzz bytes rather than uniform memset values.
